coverage: Engine Preview --enable-session-routing startup and named-pipe connection
silent shared-mode session creation and bounded catalog discovery
SessionVolumeCommand queue delivery with dB readback and restoration
SessionRouteCommand candidate graph commit with route=ready catalog readback
SessionRouteRuleCommand Upsert matched by bounded display-name metadata
SessionRouteRuleCommand Remove and catalog transition ready-to-pending
no endpoint, session or process identity printed

limitations: This proves the user-space IPC, EngineControl queue, COM-worker candidate graph/rule transaction and bounded catalog state; it does not prove physical per-App capture/re-send, process-loopback delivery, a signed virtual endpoint, WaveRT/PortCls, HLK or Microsoft signing.
The probe changes only its own silent session and uses explicit -WriteTest; it must never run implicitly from CI or application startup.
The local machine is Windows 26200/Visual Studio 17 with SDK 26100, below the locked Windows 11 24H2/VS 2026/WDK target.
